name: Query letter
description: A one-page letter to a literary agent with a simple letterhead you can style.

fields.label: Opening (why this agent, and the book in a sentence)
fields.default: I am seeking representation for TITLE, a complete 80,000-word novel. Because you represent stories with faith and heart, I hope it will be a good fit for your list.

fields.label: The story
fields.default: Who the main character is, what she wants, what stands in her way, and what she stands to lose.

fields.label: About you
fields.default: A few sentences about you and why you are the one to tell this story.

fields.label: Closing
fields.default: Thank you for your time and consideration. The full manuscript is available on request.

css: .t-page{background:#fff;color:#1d1b18;padding:.9in 1in;font-family:var(--font);font-size:var(--size);line-height:1.45}.ql-head{padding-bottom:.12in;margin-bottom:.3in}.align-center .ql-head{text-align:center}.ql-head h1{font-size:22pt;font-weight:500;margin:0;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.03em}.ql-head p{margin:.04in 0 0;font-size:10pt;opacity:.8}.rule-thin .ql-head{border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}.rule-double .ql-head{border-bottom:4px double var(--accent)}.rule-bold .ql-head{border-bottom:3px solid var(--accent)}.ql-body p{margin:0 0 .14in}.ql-date:empty{display:none}.ql-sign{margin-top:.2in!important}
